notes.title: 1.4.3 Released! Achievements and Performance Improvements
notes.notes: At long last we have enabled achievements in Cube Full of Mines!  We hope that you have fun with those.  We also took the opportunity to update to the latest version of Unreal which should mean most players will see a performance improvement of around 30%.  In addition we fixed a few minor bugs.

notes.title: New theme Snowfall and Bundle
notes.notes:
We're bringing a little bit of winter cheer for all of you with the release of our new theme Snowfall! This new DLC is available for purchase today.

We're also releasing the Quad Pack.  A bundle of all our DLC in one bundle!

notes.title: Oasis DLC Released
notes.notes: Continue your search for mines in a brand new location a desert Oasis.

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes: Perceptual Games is pleased to announce the release of our first game Cube Full of Mines.  Thanks to all who supported us and helped bring this to fruition.  Please enjoy and leave feedback in the discussion forums.
